title: I-Bonds and TIPS for inflation protection
summary: Government-backed inflation-protected vehicles. Small but useful diversifier against unexpected inflation.
detailsHtml:
I-Bonds

Series I Savings Bonds earn a fixed rate plus the inflation rate, reset every six months. $10,000 per person per year electronic purchase limit. (Note: Treasury announced October 17, 2024 the discontinuation of the paper-bond-via-tax-refund option effective with tax year 2024 filings — meaning refunds filed in early 2025 were the last to use it; the option is no longer available in 2026.) Cannot redeem within first year; 3-month interest penalty if redeemed within five years; interest is federal-taxable but state-tax-free. Best for the inflation-hedging slice of fixed income, particularly if held in a taxable account where the state tax exemption helps.

TIPS

Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities adjust principal with CPI. Available in unlimited amounts. Generally best held in tax-deferred accounts because the inflation adjustment is taxable annually even though not received until maturity ("phantom income").
